title: Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) — Enrollment Terms: Draft, Fee, Consent, Channels and Other Programs
content:
# Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans): Enrollment Terms

These are the terms of enrollment that apply to each plan of Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans): whether automatic bank draft is required, the enrollment fee, whether the member's own confirmation of the plan terms is required, the channels through which enrollment is taken, and whether a plan may sit on the same service account as PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) or an active payment arrangement.

## Terms by plan

| Plan | Automatic bank draft required | Enrollment fee | Member's own confirmation of the plan terms required | Enrollment channels | May coexist with PrePay Power on the account | May coexist with an active payment arrangement on the account |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Levelized Billing Rolling Average | No | $0.00 | Yes | phone, SmartHub, office | No | No |
| Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up | No | $0.00 | Yes | phone, SmartHub, office | No | No |
| Budget Billing Quarterly Review | No | $0.00 | Yes | phone, SmartHub, office | No | No |
| Farm Budget Billing | No | $0.00 | Yes | phone, SmartHub, office | No | No |
| Small Business Budget Billing | No | $0.00 | Yes | phone, SmartHub, office | No | No |
| Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan | Yes | $0.00 | Yes | phone, SmartHub, office | No | No |

## The terms in words

- **Automatic bank draft.** Only the Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan requires the service account to be on automatic bank draft. The other five plans do not require it.
- **Enrollment fee.** The enrollment fee is $0.00 on every plan; no plan bills a fee to enroll.
- **Member's confirmation.** On every plan the member's own confirmation of the plan terms is required.
- **Channels.** Enrollment in any plan is taken by phone, through SmartHub or at the office.
- **Other programs on the same account.** No plan may coexist with PrePay Power on the account, and no plan may coexist with an active payment arrangement on the account.

## Points of reference

**Which plan requires automatic bank draft?** The Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan. The other five plans do not require it.

**Does a plan cost anything to join?** No. The fee column reads $0.00 for all six plans.

**Can a plan run alongside PrePay Power or an active payment arrangement on one service account?** No plan can; every entry in the last two columns reads No.
